class.description: Routes over, under or around obstacles through VoxelLayer3D's 3D costs, with A* and straight-line shortening.
3D pure pursuit for a holonomic ROV (x, y, z, yaw) with per-axis velocity and acceleration limits.
Goal is reached when the horizontal, vertical and yaw errors are all within tolerance.
Progress is moving a 3D distance or turning an angle within a time allowance.
